what: Dependency version bump zod 3 (S01-S05) -> zod 4 (S06+). After the bump, the candidate must reference zod 4 and must not present zod 3 as the current validation library (historical/migration framing is fine).

steps.candidate:
# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under tests/fixtures/invoices/ are the ground truth for payload shapes [seed, note qa-s01].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in src/domain/ [note 0].
- Use zod 3 with .strict() for payload validation; unknown keys are rejected [note qa-s03].
- Standardize on axios for all outbound HTTP calls; retry logic in response interceptor, auth in request interceptor [note qa-s02].
- Log structured JSON lines to stdout with winston; one logger instance per module [note qa-s05].
- Maintain ESLint import-order rule: imports sorted alphabetically within each file [note qa-s01].

## Known pitfalls
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
- Express error handler returns 400 for validation failures (using zod 3 .flatten()), 500 otherwise [note qa-s03].
- Credit-note schemas mirror invoice schemas; both flatten cleanly in the error handler [note qa-s04].
- Log sensitive data (e.g., card numbers) using redaction paths configured in winston [note qa-s04].
